evals.prompt: Write tests for our TransferForm React component (amount, recipient IBAN, submit). The project uses Vitest, Testing Library, MSW and Playwright.
evals.expected_output: Component tests querying by role and label, covering validation errors, loading, API error with retry and success; MSW handlers including an error; an axe check; and one Playwright end-to-end test of the happy path with getByRole and web-first assertions and no sleeps.
assertions: An API error case is tested
An automated accessibility check is included
The Playwright test has no waitForTimeout or fixed sleep
